decisions.thought: Opponent is very Steel-heavy (Aegislash, Corviknight, Gholdengo, Kingambit, Archaludon), so Garchomp's Earthquake and Sylveon's Fairy STAB hit hard. Rotom-Wash covers Corviknight and Archaludon. Skip my own Gholdengo/Kingambit due to mirror and Fairy weakness.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Steel-heavy opponent: bring Garchomp (EQ), Sylveon (Fairy), Rotom-Wash? Gholdengo mirror bad. Bring garchomp, sylveon, rotomwash.

Dragapult is at 8% and Earthquake will KO it before it can do anything meaningful, even if it outspeeds it can't survive. No need to risk Scaleshot's accuracy or waste a turn.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Dragapult at 8%, faster possibly. Scaleshot hits 2-5 times, first hit kills. Earthquake also kills (immune? No—Dragapult isn't Ground-immune; Earthquake hits Dragon/Ghost neutrally). Earthquake likely KOs. Dragapult may outspeed and KO Garchomp? At 8% it might just attack. Earthquake is safest KO.

decisions.thought: 54% MOVE: kingsshield, 21% MOVE: sacredsword, 13% MOVE: shadowball

Garchomp outspeeds and Earthquake is super effective on the 7% Aegislash, so it likely KOs before it moves. The only risk is a King's Shield attack drop, but a safe KO attempt is worth it—Sylveon can come in later regardless.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Aegislash at 7% will King's Shield. Earthquake would KO but risk taking form change... actually EQ into King's Shield drops my attack. Better: set Stealth Rock? But Aegislash may KO? At 7% it likely King's Shields. Protect could scout. Or just EQ—if it King's Shields, -2 Atk but Aegislash survives. Stealth Rock while it shields is good. Actually EQ KO: EQ super effective likely KO at 7%. If King's Shield, EQ hits shield form, -2 Atk. Better play: stealth rock is safe value. But EQ could just win if it attacks (Shadow Ball won't KO through... EQ KO first since faster). Risk is only King's Shield. Choosing EQ is aggressive; SR is safe. I'll EQ—likely KO.

decisions.hidden_reasoning: Aegislash at 7%, likely King's Shield again. Earthquake hits through? No, King's Shield protects. But EQ last turn hit into protect.
